title: Unless the Lord Builds the House

questions.question: Unless the Lord builds the house, those who build it labor in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:1 (ESV): "Unless the Lord builds the house, those who build it labor in vain."

questions.question: Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:1 (ESV): "Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in vain."

questions.question: It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:2 (ESV): "It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest,"

questions.question: Eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives to his beloved what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:2 (ESV): "...for he gives to his beloved sleep."

questions.question: Behold, children are a heritage from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:3 (ESV): "Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord,"

questions.question: The fruit of the womb is a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:3 (ESV): "the fruit of the womb a reward."

questions.question: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:4 (ESV): "Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's youth."

questions.question: Blessed is the man who fills his quiver with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:5 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who fills his quiver with them!"

questions.question: He shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:5 (ESV): "He shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 127?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127 Title: "A Song of Ascents. Of Solomon."

questions.question: What happens if the Lord does not build the house?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:1 (ESV): "...those who build it labor in vain."

questions.question: What happens if the Lord does not watch over the city?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:1 (ESV): "...the watchman stays awake in vain."

questions.question: The psalm contrasts anxious toil with what gift from God?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:2 (ESV): "...for he gives to his beloved sleep."

questions.question: Children of one's youth are compared to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:4 (ESV): "Like arrows in the hand of a warrior..."

questions.question: Where will the man with many children not be put to shame?
questions.explanation: Psalm 127:5 (ESV): "...when he speaks with his enemies in the gate."

key_verse_text: Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord, the fruit of the womb a reward.
